definitions.full: H2650. Chuppim חֻמִּים proper name, masculine a son of Benjamin Gen 46:21 ( ᵐ5 Οφιμ ( ε ) ιν, Οφμειν ), descendant of Benjamin 1Chr 7:15 ( ᵐ5 Αμφειν, Αφφειν, ᵐ5 L Οφερ ), and so חֻפִם 7:15 ; see הוּמָּם . II. חפף (Late Hebrew חָפַף ; Aramaic חֲפַף , , all rub, cleanse , especially the head) compare Nö ZMG:lvii (1903), 415 .

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, Ashbel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Rosh, Muppim, Huppim, and Ard.
So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.
Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.
